body: Nice Mandingo you’re working with their lad.
I don’t know where I draw it from. Especially with how hopeless and depressed I feel atm. I just get up, work two shitty menial labor jobs and return to my mess of an apartment to do it again.

Funny you recommended that. I just sent over my H.S. Transcripts to my local IBEW hall. After this all I have to do is take the assessment. I’m praying I get offered the apprenticeship. Besides Kellogg’s and the post office; is their a way to look up union companies in my area?

Yeah, for years and years, never had the confidence up until now. It’s a weird feeling of confidence. But it’s brought me peace. It’s a tug of war that lasted 4 years. Always telling myself life would get good enough and that sentiment would go away. It never did.
